LanguageData.LP_AnestheticCollar.label: anesthetic slave collar
LanguageData.LP_AnestheticCollar.description: A steel slave collar hiding a compressed anesthetic capsule and a sensor needle. The moment a slave wearing it starts a rebellion, incites rebellion or goes berserk and hurts someone, the collar injects anesthetic into the neck, knocking them out on the spot for about half a day; after waking the slave is more compliant (suppression +30%).\n\nOnce the capsule is used up it takes about two days to refill, during which the collar won't trigger again (the inspect pane shows the remaining time). Only works on slaves; slightly heavier than an ordinary slave collar, with the same suppression effect.
